items.question: Trong câu "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", từ "rearrange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", what does "rearrange" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put in a new order
items.explanation: rearrange /ˌriːəˈreɪndʒ/ (động từ): sắp xếp lại. "Rearrange the items" = sắp xếp lại các phần tử; tiền tố "re-" nghĩa là "lại".
items.explanationEn: rearrange /ˌriːəˈreɪndʒ/ (verb): to put in a new order. "Rearrange the items" means changing their order; the prefix "re-" means "again".

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", từ "revenue" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", what does "revenue" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: revenue /ˈrevənjuː/ (danh từ): doanh thu. Thường gặp trong cụm "sort by revenue" (sắp theo doanh thu) hoặc "annual revenue" (doanh thu năm).
items.explanationEn: revenue /ˈrevənjuː/ (noun): money earned from sales. Common in "sort by revenue" or "annual revenue" (income for a year).

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", từ "alphabetically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting is rearranging the items of a collection so they follow some order: numbers from smallest to largest, names alphabetically, movies by release year or by revenue.", what does "alphabetically" (adverb) mean?
optionsEn: in the order of the alphabet
items.explanation: alphabetically /ˌælfəˈbetɪkli/ (trạng từ): theo thứ tự chữ cái. "Sort names alphabetically" = sắp tên theo bảng chữ cái (A đến Z).
items.explanationEn: alphabetically /ˌælfəˈbetɪkli/ (adverb): in the order of the alphabet. "Sort names alphabetically" means ordering them from A to Z.

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting is everywhere, and it is often the first step of another algorithm: binary search, two pointers and duplicate detection all get easier on sorted data.", từ "duplicate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting is everywhere, and it is often the first step of another algorithm: binary search, two pointers and duplicate detection all get easier on sorted data.", what does "duplicate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (tính từ): trùng lặp. "Duplicate detection" = phát hiện phần tử trùng lặp; "remove duplicates" = loại bỏ bản trùng.
items.explanationEn: duplicate /ˈdjuːplɪkət/ (adjective): exactly like another one. "Duplicate detection" means finding repeated values; "remove duplicates" means deleting the repeats.

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting is everywhere, and it is often the first step of another algorithm: binary search, two pointers and duplicate detection all get easier on sorted data.", từ "detection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting is everywhere, and it is often the first step of another algorithm: binary search, two pointers and duplicate detection all get easier on sorted data.", what does "detection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (danh từ): sự phát hiện. Danh từ của "detect" (phát hiện); hay gặp: "cycle detection", "error detection".
items.explanationEn: detection /dɪˈtekʃn/ (noun): the act of discovering something. The noun of "detect"; common in "cycle detection" and "error detection".

items.question: Trong câu "So why study slow O(n²) algorithms when every language ships a fast sort?", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "So why study slow O(n²) algorithms when every language ships a fast sort?", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to include in a released product
to take out of a product
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): đi kèm sẵn. Trong phần mềm, "ship a feature" = phát hành, đưa tính năng vào sản phẩm cho người dùng.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to include in a released product. In software, "ship a feature" means releasing it to users as part of the product.

items.question: Trong câu "One of them, insertion sort, is genuinely used in production — inside hybrid sorts, for small or nearly sorted arrays.", từ "genuinely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One of them, insertion sort, is genuinely used in production — inside hybrid sorts, for small or nearly sorted arrays.", what does "genuinely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (trạng từ): thực sự. "Genuinely used" = thực sự được dùng (không chỉ để học); tính từ là "genuine" (thật, chân chính).
items.explanationEn: genuinely /ˈdʒenjuɪnli/ (adverb): truly, really. "Genuinely used" means really used, not just taught; the adjective is "genuine".

items.question: Trong câu "One of them, insertion sort, is genuinely used in production — inside hybrid sorts, for small or nearly sorted arrays.", từ "hybrid" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One of them, insertion sort, is genuinely used in production — inside hybrid sorts, for small or nearly sorted arrays.", what does "hybrid" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hybrid /ˈhaɪbrɪd/ (tính từ): lai, kết hợp. "Hybrid sort" = thuật toán sắp xếp lai, kết hợp nhiều thuật toán; cũng gặp "hybrid cloud", "hybrid car".
items.explanationEn: hybrid /ˈhaɪbrɪd/ (adjective): mixing two or more kinds. "Hybrid sort" combines several algorithms; also seen in "hybrid cloud" and "hybrid car".

items.question: Trong câu "Interviewers ask you to write them, trace them, and explain their best and worst cases.", từ "trace" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Interviewers ask you to write them, trace them, and explain their best and worst cases.", what does "trace" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trace /treɪs/ (động từ): lần theo từng bước. "Trace an algorithm" = chạy tay từng bước để xem giá trị thay đổi ra sao; danh từ "stack trace".
items.explanationEn: trace /treɪs/ (verb): to follow each step. "Trace an algorithm" means following it step by step by hand; compare the noun "stack trace".

items.question: Trong câu "Without a comparator, sort converts every element to a string and compares them by UTF-16 code units.", từ "convert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without a comparator, sort converts every element to a string and compares them by UTF-16 code units.", what does "convert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (động từ): chuyển đổi. Cấu trúc "convert A to/into B" = chuyển A thành B, ví dụ "convert a number to a string".
items.explanationEn: convert /kənˈvɜːt/ (verb): to change into another form. Pattern: "convert A to/into B", e.g. "convert a number to a string".

items.question: Trong câu "sort mutates the array in place and returns the same array, not a copy.", từ "mutate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "sort mutates the array in place and returns the same array, not a copy.", what does "mutate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (động từ): thay đổi trực tiếp. Trong lập trình, "mutate the array" = sửa chính mảng gốc; trái nghĩa là "immutable" (bất biến).
items.explanationEn: mutate /mjuːˈteɪt/ (verb): to change the original. In programming, "mutate the array" means changing the original; the opposite idea is "immutable".

items.question: Trong câu "Use toSorted() (ES2023) or [...arr].sort() when the original must stay untouched.", từ "untouched" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use toSorted() (ES2023) or [...arr].sort() when the original must stay untouched.", what does "untouched" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (tính từ): nguyên vẹn. "Stay/remain untouched" = giữ nguyên, không bị thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: untouched /ʌnˈtʌtʃt/ (adjective): not changed at all. "Stay/remain untouched" means staying exactly as it was.

items.question: Trong câu "Since ES2019 the specification requires the sort to be stable.", từ "specification" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Since ES2019 the specification requires the sort to be stable.", what does "specification" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: specification /ˌspesɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (danh từ): bản đặc tả. "The ECMAScript specification" = bản đặc tả chính thức của JavaScript; viết tắt "spec".
items.explanationEn: specification /ˌspesɪfɪˈkeɪʃn/ (noun): a formal technical standard. "The ECMAScript specification" is the official definition of JavaScript; often shortened to "spec".

items.question: Trong câu "Since ES2019 the specification requires the sort to be stable.", từ "stable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Since ES2019 the specification requires the sort to be stable.", what does "stable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: stable /ˈsteɪbl/ (tính từ): ổn định (giữ thứ tự gốc). "A stable sort" giữ nguyên thứ tự ban đầu của các phần tử có khóa bằng nhau.
items.explanationEn: stable /ˈsteɪbl/ (adjective): keeping equal items in order. "A stable sort" keeps the original order of elements with equal keys.

items.question: Trong câu "Inconsistent results: a comparator must always give the same answer for the same pair; a random comparator is not a correct shuffle.", từ "inconsistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inconsistent results: a comparator must always give the same answer for the same pair; a random comparator is not a correct shuffle.", what does "inconsistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): không nhất quán. "Inconsistent results" = kết quả lúc thế này lúc thế khác; trái nghĩa "consistent".
items.explanationEn: inconsistent /ˌɪnkənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): not the same each time. "Inconsistent results" change from one run to another; the opposite is "consistent".

items.question: Trong câu "Inconsistent results: a comparator must always give the same answer for the same pair; a random comparator is not a correct shuffle.", từ "shuffle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inconsistent results: a comparator must always give the same answer for the same pair; a random comparator is not a correct shuffle.", what does "shuffle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: shuffle /ˈʃʌfl/ (danh từ): sự xáo trộn. "A correct shuffle" = cách xáo trộn đúng, mọi hoán vị có xác suất như nhau (ví dụ Fisher–Yates).
items.explanationEn: shuffle /ˈʃʌfl/ (noun): a random reordering. "A correct shuffle" gives every ordering the same chance (e.g. Fisher–Yates).

items.question: Trong câu "Compare explicitly with < and > if those values can appear.", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Compare explicitly with < and > if those values can appear.", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (trạng từ): một cách tường minh. "Explicitly" = viết rõ ra trong code; trái nghĩa "implicitly" (ngầm định).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Explicitly" means written out clearly in the code; the opposite is "implicitly".

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble sort and selection sort move elements by swapping two positions.", từ "swap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble sort and selection sort move elements by swapping two positions.", what does "swap" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: swap /swɒp/ (động từ): hoán đổi. "Swap A and B" = đổi chỗ A và B; danh từ "a swap" = một lần hoán đổi.
items.explanationEn: swap /swɒp/ (verb): to exchange two things. "Swap A and B" means they trade places; the noun "a swap" is one exchange.

items.question: Trong câu "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", từ "allocate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", what does "allocate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (động từ): cấp phát (bộ nhớ). "Allocate memory" = cấp phát bộ nhớ; danh từ "allocation".
items.explanationEn: allocate /ˈæləkeɪt/ (verb): to set aside memory for. "Allocate memory" means reserving memory; the noun is "allocation".

items.question: Trong câu "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", từ "temporary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", what does "temporary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: temporary /ˈtemprəri/ (tính từ): tạm thời. "A temporary variable" (thường đặt tên "temp") = biến tạm để giữ giá trị trong lúc hoán đổi.
items.explanationEn: temporary /ˈtemprəri/ (adjective): lasting a short time. "A temporary variable" (often "temp") holds a value briefly, e.g. during a swap.

items.question: Trong câu "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", từ "hot loop" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The temp-variable version avoids allocating a small temporary array, which can matter inside a hot loop, but either is correct.", what does "hot loop" (phrase) mean?
options: vòng lặp chạy rất nhiều lần
optionsEn: a loop that has a bug
a loop that runs very often
items.explanation: hot loop /hɒt luːp/ (cụm từ): vòng lặp chạy rất nhiều lần. "Hot loop" / "hot path" = đoạn code chạy rất thường xuyên, nên tối ưu hiệu năng ở đó.
items.explanationEn: hot loop /hɒt luːp/ (phrase): a loop that runs very often. "Hot loop" or "hot path" is code that runs very often, so performance matters there.

items.question: Trong câu "The sorts below reuse swap.", từ "reuse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The sorts below reuse swap.", what does "reuse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (động từ): dùng lại. "Reuse a helper" = dùng lại hàm tiện ích thay vì viết lặp lại; tính từ "reusable".
items.explanationEn: reuse /ˌriːˈjuːz/ (verb): to use again. "Reuse a helper" means calling it again instead of rewriting it; the adjective is "reusable".

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble sort walks through the array comparing adjacent pairs and swaps any pair that is out of order.", từ "adjacent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble sort walks through the array comparing adjacent pairs and swaps any pair that is out of order.", what does "adjacent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adjacent /əˈdʒeɪsnt/ (tính từ): kề nhau. "Adjacent elements" = các phần tử nằm cạnh nhau; cũng gặp "adjacent nodes" trong đồ thị.
items.explanationEn: adjacent /əˈdʒeɪsnt/ (adjective): next to each other. "Adjacent elements" sit side by side; also used for "adjacent nodes" in graphs.

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble sort walks through the array comparing adjacent pairs and swaps any pair that is out of order.", từ "out of order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble sort walks through the array comparing adjacent pairs and swaps any pair that is out of order.", what does "out of order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: out of order /aʊt əv ˈɔːdə/ (cụm từ): sai thứ tự. "A pair out of order" = cặp đứng sai thứ tự; nghĩa khác: "The lift is out of order" = thang máy hỏng.
items.explanationEn: out of order /aʊt əv ˈɔːdə/ (phrase): in the wrong sequence. "A pair out of order" is in the wrong sequence; another sense: "The lift is out of order" means broken.

items.question: Trong câu "Each next pass can stop one position earlier.", từ "pass" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each next pass can stop one position earlier.", what does "pass" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: pass /pɑːs/ (danh từ): lượt duyệt. "One pass over the array" = một lượt duyệt qua mảng; "single-pass algorithm" = thuật toán chỉ duyệt một lần.
items.explanationEn: pass /pɑːs/ (noun): one run through the data. "One pass over the array" is one full walk through it; a "single-pass algorithm" walks through once.

items.question: Trong câu "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", từ "flag" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", what does "flag" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a cloth symbol of a country
items.explanation: flag /flæɡ/ (danh từ): cờ (biến đánh dấu). "A boolean flag" = biến true/false đánh dấu một điều đã xảy ra, ví dụ "swapped".
items.explanationEn: flag /flæɡ/ (noun): a variable marking a state. "A boolean flag" is a true/false variable that records whether something happened, e.g. "swapped".

items.question: Trong câu "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", từ "early exit" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", what does "early exit" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: early exit /ˈɜːli ˈeksɪt/ (cụm từ): dừng sớm. "Early exit" = thoát khỏi vòng lặp/hàm sớm khi đã có kết quả, thường bằng "break" hoặc "return".
items.explanationEn: early exit /ˈɜːli ˈeksɪt/ (phrase): stopping before the usual end. "Early exit" means leaving a loop or function once the result is known, usually with "break" or "return".

items.question: Trong câu "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", từ "optimisation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The swapped flag is the early exit optimisation.", what does "optimisation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: optimisation /ˌɒptɪmaɪˈzeɪʃn/ (danh từ): sự tối ưu hóa. Chính tả Anh "optimisation", Mỹ "optimization"; "premature optimisation" = tối ưu quá sớm.
items.explanationEn: optimisation /ˌɒptɪmaɪˈzeɪʃn/ (noun): making something work better. British spelling "optimisation", American "optimization"; "premature optimisation" means optimising too early.

items.question: Trong câu "Using >= would break stability.", từ "stability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Using >= would break stability.", what does "stability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: stability /stəˈbɪləti/ (danh từ): tính ổn định. Với thuật toán sắp xếp, "break stability" = làm mất tính ổn định (đảo thứ tự các phần tử bằng nhau).
items.explanationEn: stability /stəˈbɪləti/ (noun): the quality of being stable. For sorts, "break stability" means equal elements may lose their original order.

items.question: Trong câu "Each swap fixes exactly one inversion (a pair that is out of order), so the number of swaps equals the number of inversions in the input.", từ "inversion" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each swap fixes exactly one inversion (a pair that is out of order), so the number of swaps equals the number of inversions in the input.", what does "inversion" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a pair in the wrong order
items.explanation: inversion /ɪnˈvɜːʃn/ (danh từ): cặp nghịch thế. "Count inversions" = đếm số cặp (i < j) mà arr[i] > arr[j]; đo mức "chưa sắp xếp" của mảng.
items.explanationEn: inversion /ɪnˈvɜːʃn/ (noun): a pair in the wrong order. "Count inversions" means counting pairs i < j with arr[i] > arr[j]; it measures how unsorted an array is.

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble sort is stable: it swaps only when arr[j] > arr[j + 1] (strictly greater), so equal elements never jump over each other.", từ "strictly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble sort is stable: it swaps only when arr[j] > arr[j + 1] (strictly greater), so equal elements never jump over each other.", what does "strictly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (trạng từ): hoàn toàn, chặt chẽ. "Strictly greater" = lớn hơn hẳn (>, không tính bằng); "strictly increasing" = tăng ngặt.
items.explanationEn: strictly /ˈstrɪktli/ (adverb): exactly, with no exceptions. "Strictly greater" means > with equality excluded; "strictly increasing" allows no equal neighbours.

items.question: Trong câu "Selection sort is the mirror image: instead of pushing large values to the end, it selects the smallest remaining value and places it at the front.", từ "mirror image" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Selection sort is the mirror image: instead of pushing large values to the end, it selects the smallest remaining value and places it at the front.", what does "mirror image" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: mirror image /ˈmɪrər ˈɪmɪdʒ/ (cụm từ): phiên bản ngược lại. "A is the mirror image of B" = A giống B nhưng theo hướng ngược lại.
items.explanationEn: mirror image /ˈmɪrər ˈɪmɪdʒ/ (phrase): the reverse version of something. "A is the mirror image of B" means A works like B but in the opposite direction.

items.question: Trong câu "Selection sort is the mirror image: instead of pushing large values to the end, it selects the smallest remaining value and places it at the front.", từ "remaining" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Selection sort is the mirror image: instead of pushing large values to the end, it selects the smallest remaining value and places it at the front.", what does "remaining" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (tính từ): còn lại. "The remaining elements" = các phần tử còn lại; động từ gốc "remain" (vẫn còn).
items.explanationEn: remaining /rɪˈmeɪnɪŋ/ (adjective): still left over. "The remaining elements" are those still left; the base verb is "remain".

items.question: Trong câu "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt qua, rà soát. "Scan the array" = duyệt lần lượt từng phần tử để tìm kiếm; "a linear scan" = duyệt tuyến tính.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to look through in order. "Scan the array" means checking elements one by one; "a linear scan" does this from start to end.

items.question: Trong câu "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", từ "whenever" (liên từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", what does "whenever" (conjunction) mean?
items.explanation: whenever /wenˈevə/ (liên từ): bất cứ khi nào. "Whenever X happens, do Y" = mỗi lần X xảy ra thì làm Y.
items.explanationEn: whenever /wenˈevə/ (conjunction): every time that. "Whenever X happens, do Y" means doing Y every time X happens.

items.question: Trong câu "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", từ "index" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scan the rest of the array; whenever a smaller value appears, remember its index.", what does "index" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: an alphabetical list in a book
the data stored in a slot
a position number in a list
the number of items in a list
items.explanation: index /ˈɪndeks/ (danh từ): chỉ số (vị trí). Số nhiều "indices" hoặc "indexes"; "zero-based index" = chỉ số bắt đầu từ 0.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪndeks/ (noun): a position number in a list. Plural "indices" or "indexes"; a "zero-based index" starts counting at 0.

items.question: Trong câu "it still scans to confirm each minimum", từ "confirm" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "it still scans to confirm each minimum", what does "confirm" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to make sure it is true
items.explanation: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (động từ): xác nhận. "Confirm that ..." = xác nhận rằng...; danh từ "confirmation".
items.explanationEn: confirm /kənˈfɜːm/ (verb): to make sure it is true. "Confirm that ..." means checking that something is true; the noun is "confirmation".

items.question: Trong câu "Selection sort always scans the whole unsorted part, whatever the input looks like.", từ "unsorted" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Selection sort always scans the whole unsorted part, whatever the input looks like.", what does "unsorted" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: unsorted /ʌnˈsɔːtɪd/ (tính từ): chưa sắp xếp. Tiền tố "un-" mang nghĩa phủ định: "the unsorted part" = phần chưa được sắp xếp.
items.explanationEn: unsorted /ʌnˈsɔːtɪd/ (adjective): not yet put in order. The prefix "un-" means "not": "the unsorted part" is the section not yet in order.

items.question: Trong câu "Not adaptive: sorted input does not help at all.", từ "adaptive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not adaptive: sorted input does not help at all.", what does "adaptive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: adaptive /əˈdæptɪv/ (tính từ): thích ứng. "An adaptive sort" chạy nhanh hơn khi dữ liệu đã gần được sắp xếp; động từ "adapt" (thích nghi).
items.explanationEn: adaptive /əˈdæptɪv/ (adjective): adjusting to the input. "An adaptive sort" runs faster when the input is already partly sorted; the verb is "adapt".

items.question: Trong câu "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", từ "advantage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", what does "advantage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: advantage /ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (danh từ): ưu điểm. "The advantage of X" = ưu điểm của X; trái nghĩa "disadvantage"; "take advantage of" = tận dụng.
items.explanationEn: advantage /ədˈvɑːntɪdʒ/ (noun): a helpful quality. "The advantage of X" is its benefit; the opposite is "disadvantage"; "take advantage of" means to make use of.

items.question: Trong câu "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", từ "minimise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", what does "minimise" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to raise to the highest amount
to reduce to the lowest amount
to shrink a window on screen
to count items one by one
items.explanation: minimise /ˈmɪnɪmaɪz/ (động từ): giảm thiểu. "Minimise swaps" = giảm số lần hoán đổi xuống ít nhất; Mỹ viết "minimize", trái nghĩa "maximise".
items.explanationEn: minimise /ˈmɪnɪmaɪz/ (verb): to reduce to the lowest amount. "Minimise swaps" means keeping them as few as possible; American "minimize", opposite "maximise".

items.question: Trong câu "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", từ "cycle" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is its one real advantage: when a write is very expensive (for example flash memory with limited write cycles), minimising swaps can matter more than comparisons.", what does "cycle" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (danh từ): chu kỳ. "Write cycles" = số lần ghi/xóa mà bộ nhớ flash chịu được; cũng gặp "CPU cycles", "life cycle".
items.explanationEn: cycle /ˈsaɪkl/ (noun): one round of an action. "Write cycles" is how many write/erase rounds flash memory survives; also "CPU cycles", "life cycle".

items.question: Trong câu "Not stable: the long-distance swap can jump an element over its equal twin.", từ "twin" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Not stable: the long-distance swap can jump an element over its equal twin.", what does "twin" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: twin /twɪn/ (danh từ): cái giống hệt. Nghĩa gốc "twin" = anh/chị em sinh đôi; ở đây là phần tử có giá trị bằng hệt phần tử kia.
items.explanationEn: twin /twɪn/ (noun): one of two matching things. Literally "twin" is one of two siblings born together; here it is an element with an equal key.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort builds a sorted left part one element at a time, like arranging a hand of playing cards.", từ "arrange" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort builds a sorted left part one element at a time, like arranging a hand of playing cards.", what does "arrange" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (động từ): sắp xếp. "Arrange cards" = xếp bài theo thứ tự; nghĩa khác: "arrange a meeting" = sắp xếp một cuộc họp.
items.explanationEn: arrange /əˈreɪndʒ/ (verb): to put in order. "Arrange cards" means putting them in order; another sense: "arrange a meeting" means planning it.

items.question: Trong câu "Take the next element, slide it left past every larger element, and drop it into the gap.", từ "slide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Take the next element, slide it left past every larger element, and drop it into the gap.", what does "slide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: slide /slaɪd/ (động từ): trượt, dịch dần. "Slide it left" = dịch dần sang trái; cũng gặp "sliding window" (cửa sổ trượt).
items.explanationEn: slide /slaɪd/ (verb): to move smoothly along. "Slide it left" means moving it gradually leftwards; compare "sliding window".

items.question: Trong câu "Take the next element, slide it left past every larger element, and drop it into the gap.", từ "gap" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Take the next element, slide it left past every larger element, and drop it into the gap.", what does "gap" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: gap /ɡæp/ (danh từ): chỗ trống. "Drop it into the gap" = đặt vào chỗ trống; nghĩa khác: "the gap between rich and poor" = khoảng cách giàu nghèo.
items.explanationEn: gap /ɡæp/ (noun): an empty space. "Drop it into the gap" means placing it in the empty slot; another sense: "the gap between rich and poor".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to move to a new position
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển. "Shift elements right" = dời các phần tử sang phải một ô; JS có "arr.shift()" (bỏ phần tử đầu).
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): to move to a new position. "Shift elements right" means moving each one step right; JS also has "arr.shift()" which removes the first item.

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", từ "implementation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", what does "implementation" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the code that carries it out
items.explanation: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (danh từ): bản cài đặt (mã). "The usual implementation" = cách viết code thông thường; động từ "implement" (hiện thực, cài đặt).
items.explanationEn: implementation /ˌɪmplɪmenˈteɪʃn/ (noun): the code that carries it out. "The usual implementation" is the common way to code it; the verb is "implement".

items.question: Trong câu "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", từ "repeated" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Instead of repeated swaps, the usual implementation shifts larger elements one step right and writes the saved value once:", what does "repeated" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: repeated /rɪˈpiːtɪd/ (tính từ): lặp đi lặp lại. "Repeated swaps" = nhiều lần hoán đổi liên tiếp; động từ "repeat".
items.explanationEn: repeated /rɪˈpiːtɪd/ (adjective): happening many times. "Repeated swaps" are many swaps one after another; the verb is "repeat".

items.question: Trong câu "The loop condition is j >= 0.", từ "condition" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The loop condition is j >= 0.", what does "condition" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a rule that must be true
items.explanation: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (danh từ): điều kiện. "Loop condition" = điều kiện để vòng lặp tiếp tục chạy; "on condition that" = với điều kiện là.
items.explanationEn: condition /kənˈdɪʃn/ (noun): a rule that must be true. "Loop condition" decides whether the loop keeps running; "on condition that" means "only if".

items.question: Trong câu "More precisely, insertion sort runs in O(n + k), where k is the number of inversions.", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "More precisely, insertion sort runs in O(n + k), where k is the number of inversions.", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (trạng từ): chính xác. "More precisely" = nói chính xác hơn, dùng để bổ sung chi tiết cho câu trước.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪsli/ (adverb): exactly, in detail. "More precisely" introduces a more exact version of the previous statement.

items.question: Trong câu "On a nearly sorted array (every element only a few places from home), k is small and the sort is close to linear — often faster than O(n log n) algorithms with their bigger constant factors.", từ "linear" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a nearly sorted array (every element only a few places from home), k is small and the sort is close to linear — often faster than O(n log n) algorithms with their bigger constant factors.", what does "linear" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: linear /ˈlɪniə/ (tính từ): tuyến tính. "Linear time" = O(n), thời gian tăng tỉ lệ thuận với n; "close to linear" = gần tuyến tính.
items.explanationEn: linear /ˈlɪniə/ (adjective): growing in direct proportion. "Linear time" is O(n), growing in step with n; "close to linear" means almost O(n).

items.question: Trong câu "On a nearly sorted array (every element only a few places from home), k is small and the sort is close to linear — often faster than O(n log n) algorithms with their bigger constant factors.", từ "constant factor" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On a nearly sorted array (every element only a few places from home), k is small and the sort is close to linear — often faster than O(n log n) algorithms with their bigger constant factors.", what does "constant factor" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: constant factor /ˈkɒnstənt ˈfæktə/ (cụm từ): hệ số nhân cố định. Big O bỏ qua "constant factors", nhưng trên dữ liệu nhỏ chúng quyết định tốc độ thực tế.
items.explanationEn: constant factor /ˈkɒnstənt ˈfæktə/ (phrase): a fixed multiplier. Big O ignores "constant factors", but on small inputs they decide the real speed.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort is also an online algorithm: it can sort data as it arrives, without seeing the whole input first.", từ "arrive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort is also an online algorithm: it can sort data as it arrives, without seeing the whole input first.", what does "arrive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (động từ): đến, được gửi tới. "As data arrives" = khi dữ liệu lần lượt đến; "arrive at a result" = đi đến kết quả.
items.explanationEn: arrive /əˈraɪv/ (verb): to come in. "As data arrives" means as it comes in over time; "arrive at a result" means reaching it.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort is also an online algorithm: it can sort data as it arrives, without seeing the whole input first.", từ "online" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort is also an online algorithm: it can sort data as it arrives, without seeing the whole input first.", what does "online" (adjective) mean?
options: xử lý dữ liệu khi nó đến
items.explanation: online /ˌɒnˈlaɪn/ (tính từ): xử lý dữ liệu khi nó đến. "Online algorithm" = thuật toán xử lý từng phần tử khi nó đến; trái nghĩa "offline algorithm".
items.explanationEn: online /ˌɒnˈlaɪn/ (adjective): handling data as it comes. An "online algorithm" handles each item as it arrives; the opposite is an "offline algorithm".

items.question: Trong câu "Stable means equal keys keep their original relative order.", từ "relative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stable means equal keys keep their original relative order.", what does "relative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: relative /ˈrelətɪv/ (tính từ): tương đối (so với nhau). "Relative order" = thứ tự trước/sau giữa các phần tử với nhau; danh từ "relative" lại nghĩa là họ hàng.
items.explanationEn: relative /ˈrelətɪv/ (adjective): compared with each other. "Relative order" is which item comes before which; the noun "relative" means a family member.

items.question: Trong câu "It matters when you sort by one field after another: sort by name, then stable-sort by department, and names stay alphabetical inside each department.", từ "field" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It matters when you sort by one field after another: sort by name, then stable-sort by department, and names stay alphabetical inside each department.", what does "field" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a named part of a record
items.explanation: field /fiːld/ (danh từ): trường (dữ liệu). "Sort by one field" = sắp theo một trường như name hay age; nghĩa khác: "field" = cánh đồng, lĩnh vực.
items.explanationEn: field /fiːld/ (noun): a named part of a record. "Sort by one field" means by one property such as name or age; other senses: a piece of land, an area of study.

items.question: Trong câu "It matters when you sort by one field after another: sort by name, then stable-sort by department, and names stay alphabetical inside each department.", từ "department" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It matters when you sort by one field after another: sort by name, then stable-sort by department, and names stay alphabetical inside each department.", what does "department" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: department /dɪˈpɑːtmənt/ (danh từ): phòng ban. "Sort by department" = sắp theo phòng ban; cũng gặp "HR department", "IT department".
items.explanationEn: department /dɪˈpɑːtmənt/ (noun): a section of an organisation. "Sort by department" groups people by section; also "HR department", "IT department".

items.question: Trong câu "In place means O(1) extra memory: all three elementary sorts qualify.", từ "qualify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In place means O(1) extra memory: all three elementary sorts qualify.", what does "qualify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: qualify /ˈkwɒlɪfaɪ/ (động từ): đạt tiêu chuẩn. "All three qualify" = cả ba đều thỏa điều kiện; "qualify as in-place" = được tính là tại chỗ.
items.explanationEn: qualify /ˈkwɒlɪfaɪ/ (verb): to meet the requirements. "All three qualify" means all meet the definition; "qualify as in-place" means counting as in-place.

items.question: Trong câu "In place means O(1) extra memory: all three elementary sorts qualify.", từ "elementary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In place means O(1) extra memory: all three elementary sorts qualify.", what does "elementary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: elementary /ˌelɪˈmentri/ (tính từ): cơ bản, sơ cấp. "Elementary sorts" = các thuật toán sắp xếp cơ bản; "elementary school" = trường tiểu học.
items.explanationEn: elementary /ˌelɪˈmentri/ (adjective): basic, simple. "Elementary sorts" are the basic sorting algorithms; "elementary school" is primary school.

items.question: Trong câu "All three have quadratic average time.", từ "quadratic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "All three have quadratic average time.", what does "quadratic" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: growing with the log of n
growing with the square of n
items.explanation: quadratic /kwɒˈdrætɪk/ (tính từ): bậc hai. "Quadratic time" = O(n²); n tăng gấp đôi thì thời gian tăng khoảng bốn lần.
items.explanationEn: quadratic /kwɒˈdrætɪk/ (adjective): growing with the square of n. "Quadratic time" is O(n²); doubling n makes the time about four times larger.

items.question: Trong câu "At n = 100,000 that is on the order of 5 × 10⁹ comparisons — seconds to minutes — while an O(n log n) sort needs about 1.7 million.", từ "on the order of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "At n = 100,000 that is on the order of 5 × 10⁹ comparisons — seconds to minutes — while an O(n log n) sort needs about 1.7 million.", what does "on the order of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on the order of /ɒn ði ˈɔːdər əv/ (cụm từ): khoảng, cỡ chừng. "On the order of 10⁹" = cỡ khoảng 10⁹ (cùng bậc độ lớn); khác "by order of" = theo lệnh của.
items.explanationEn: on the order of /ɒn ði ˈɔːdər əv/ (phrase): approximately. "On the order of 10⁹" means roughly that size; different from "by order of", meaning by command of.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort is the one that earns its place in real code:", từ "earn its place" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort is the one that earns its place in real code:", what does "earn its place" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to take up a lot of space
items.explanation: earn its place /ɜːn ɪts pleɪs/ (cụm từ): xứng đáng được dùng. "X earns its place" = X chứng minh được giá trị nên xứng đáng có mặt.
items.explanationEn: earn its place /ɜːn ɪts pleɪs/ (phrase): to deserve to be included. "X earns its place" means X has proved useful enough to be included.

items.question: Trong câu "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", từ "dozen" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", what does "dozen" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: dozen /ˈdʌzn/ (danh từ): một tá (mười hai). "A few dozen elements" = vài chục phần tử; "dozens of" = hàng chục.
items.explanationEn: dozen /ˈdʌzn/ (noun): a group of twelve. "A few dozen elements" means a few tens of elements; "dozens of" means many tens.

items.question: Trong câu "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", từ "overhead" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", what does "overhead" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: overhead /ˈəʊvəhed/ (danh từ): chi phí phụ trội. "Low overhead" = tốn ít chi phí phụ (gọi hàm, cấp phát, đệ quy...).
items.explanationEn: overhead /ˈəʊvəhed/ (noun): extra cost of running. "Low overhead" means little extra work such as function calls, allocation or recursion.

items.question: Trong câu "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", từ "recursive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Small arrays: for a few dozen elements its low overhead beats recursive O(n log n) sorts.", what does "recursive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (tính từ): đệ quy. "A recursive sort" (như merge sort) gọi lại chính nó trên các phần nhỏ hơn; danh từ "recursion".
items.explanationEn: recursive /rɪˈkɜːsɪv/ (adjective): calling itself. "A recursive sort" such as merge sort calls itself on smaller parts; the noun is "recursion".

items.question: Trong câu "Hybrid sorts switch to insertion sort for small pieces: TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) uses binary insertion sort to build short runs, and many quick sort implementations fall back to it below a small threshold.", từ "fall back" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hybrid sorts switch to insertion sort for small pieces: TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) uses binary insertion sort to build short runs, and many quick sort implementations fall back to it below a small threshold.", what does "fall back" (phrase) mean?
options: chuyển sang phương án dự phòng
optionsEn: to switch to a backup option
to speed up a great deal
items.explanation: fall back /fɔːl bæk/ (cụm từ): chuyển sang phương án dự phòng. "Fall back to X" = chuyển sang dùng X khi cách chính không phù hợp; danh từ "fallback".
items.explanationEn: fall back /fɔːl bæk/ (phrase): to switch to a backup option. "Fall back to X" means using X when the main approach is not suitable; the noun is "fallback".

items.question: Trong câu "Hybrid sorts switch to insertion sort for small pieces: TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) uses binary insertion sort to build short runs, and many quick sort implementations fall back to it below a small threshold.", từ "threshold" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hybrid sorts switch to insertion sort for small pieces: TimSort (V8, Python, Java objects) uses binary insertion sort to build short runs, and many quick sort implementations fall back to it below a small threshold.", what does "threshold" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the floor strip of a doorway
a limit that triggers a change
items.explanation: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (danh từ): ngưỡng. "Below a threshold" = dưới một ngưỡng; ví dụ dưới khoảng 10–20 phần tử thì chuyển sang insertion sort.
items.explanationEn: threshold /ˈθreʃhəʊld/ (noun): a limit that triggers a change. "Below a threshold" means under a set limit, e.g. switching to insertion sort under about 10–20 items.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly sorted data: logs that are almost in timestamp order, a list after one new item was appended.", từ "append" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly sorted data: logs that are almost in timestamp order, a list after one new item was appended.", what does "append" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take out of a list
items.explanation: append /əˈpend/ (động từ): nối thêm vào cuối. "Append an item" = thêm phần tử vào cuối; trong JS tương đương "push".
items.explanationEn: append /əˈpend/ (verb): to add at the end. "Append an item" means adding it at the end; in JS this is "push".

items.question: Trong câu "Streaming data: keeping a small sorted list up to date as values arrive.", từ "up to date" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Streaming data: keeping a small sorted list up to date as values arrive.", what does "up to date" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: up to date /ʌp tə deɪt/ (cụm từ): cập nhật mới nhất. "Keep X up to date" = giữ X luôn được cập nhật; trái nghĩa "out of date".
items.explanationEn: up to date /ʌp tə deɪt/ (phrase): current, with the latest changes. "Keep X up to date" means keeping it current; the opposite is "out of date".

items.question: Trong câu "Selection sort is mostly a teaching tool; its only edge is the minimal number of swaps.", từ "edge" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Selection sort is mostly a teaching tool; its only edge is the minimal number of swaps.", what does "edge" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: edge /edʒ/ (danh từ): lợi thế. "Have an edge over X" = có lợi thế hơn X; nghĩa khác: "edge" = cạnh (đồ thị), mép.
items.explanationEn: edge /edʒ/ (noun): a slight advantage. "Have an edge over X" means having an advantage; other senses: a border, or an edge in a graph.

items.question: Trong câu "Bubble sort is almost never the best choice in practice.", từ "in practice" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Bubble sort is almost never the best choice in practice.", what does "in practice" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (cụm từ): trong thực tế. "In practice" = trong thực tế, thường đối lập với "in theory" (trên lý thuyết).
items.explanationEn: in practice /ɪn ˈpræktɪs/ (phrase): in real situations. "In practice" means in real use, often contrasted with "in theory".

items.question: Trong câu "For general-purpose sorting in JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a correct comparator.", từ "general-purpose" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For general-purpose sorting in JavaScript, use the built-in sort with a correct comparator.", what does "general-purpose" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: general-purpose /ˌdʒenrəl ˈpɜːpəs/ (tính từ): đa dụng. "General-purpose" = dùng được cho nhiều trường hợp; trái nghĩa "special-purpose".
items.explanationEn: general-purpose /ˌdʒenrəl ˈpɜːpəs/ (adjective): suitable for many uses. "General-purpose" means usable in many situations; the opposite is "special-purpose".

items.question: Trong câu "When tracing, state which region is sorted after each pass: the right end for bubble sort, the left end for selection and insertion sort.", từ "state" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When tracing, state which region is sorted after each pass: the right end for bubble sort, the left end for selection and insertion sort.", what does "state" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: state /steɪt/ (động từ): nêu rõ. "State which region is sorted" = nói rõ vùng nào đã sắp xếp; danh từ "state" lại nghĩa là trạng thái.
items.explanationEn: state /steɪt/ (verb): to say clearly. "State which region is sorted" means saying it clearly; the noun "state" means a condition.

items.question: Trong câu "When tracing, state which region is sorted after each pass: the right end for bubble sort, the left end for selection and insertion sort.", từ "region" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When tracing, state which region is sorted after each pass: the right end for bubble sort, the left end for selection and insertion sort.", what does "region" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: region /ˈriːdʒən/ (danh từ): phần, đoạn. "The sorted region" = đoạn mảng đã được sắp xếp; trong AWS "region" là vùng địa lý.
items.explanationEn: region /ˈriːdʒən/ (noun): a part or section. "The sorted region" is the part of the array already in order; in AWS a "region" is a geographic area.

items.question: Trong câu "Choose insertion sort for small or nearly sorted data; it is the building block inside hybrid sorts like TimSort.", từ "building block" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Choose insertion sort for small or nearly sorted data; it is the building block inside hybrid sorts like TimSort.", what does "building block" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a basic part of a bigger thing
items.explanation: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (cụm từ): thành phần nền tảng. "The building block of X" = thành phần cơ bản để tạo nên X.
items.explanationEn: building block /ˈbɪldɪŋ blɒk/ (phrase): a basic part of a bigger thing. "The building block of X" is a basic piece used to build X.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript's sort is stable, O(n log n) and mutates the array you pass, but it compares strings unless you supply a comparator.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript's sort is stable, O(n log n) and mutates the array you pass, but it compares strings unless you supply a comparator.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply a comparator" = truyền vào một hàm so sánh; danh từ "supply" = nguồn cung.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. "Supply a comparator" means passing one in; the noun "supply" means a stock or source.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort shines on small, nearly sorted and streaming data, which is why fast hybrid sorts use it internally.", từ "shine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort shines on small, nearly sorted and streaming data, which is why fast hybrid sorts use it internally.", what does "shine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shine /ʃaɪn/ (động từ): làm rất tốt. "X shines on Y" = X đặc biệt hiệu quả với Y; nghĩa gốc là chiếu sáng.
items.explanationEn: shine /ʃaɪn/ (verb): to do very well. "X shines on Y" means X performs especially well on Y; the literal sense is giving off light.

items.question: Trong câu "Insertion sort shines on small, nearly sorted and streaming data, which is why fast hybrid sorts use it internally.", từ "internally" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Insertion sort shines on small, nearly sorted and streaming data, which is why fast hybrid sorts use it internally.", what does "internally" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: internally /ɪnˈtɜːnəli/ (trạng từ): ở bên trong. "Use it internally" = dùng bên trong (người dùng không thấy); trái nghĩa "externally".
items.explanationEn: internally /ɪnˈtɜːnəli/ (adverb): on the inside. "Use it internally" means inside the implementation, hidden from users; the opposite is "externally".
